title: BigP3BCI Study H — 9x8 checkerboard with gaze conditions (16 healthy subjects)
description: This dataset comprises EEG recordings from 16 healthy subjects performing a P300-based brain-computer interface task using a 9x8 checkerboard stimulus grid with gaze conditions. The data were acquired at 256 Hz using 16 channels in a standard 10-20 montage and include target and non-target event classifications for P300 detection and speller applications. This derivative dataset is part of the BigP3BCI project, the largest public P300 BCI dataset containing recordings from approximately 267 subjects across multiple studies.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 256 Hz sampling rate using 16 channels arranged in a standard 10-20 montage with a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec). The experimental paradigm employed a P300 visual oddball task with a 9x8 checkerboard stimulus grid and gaze conditions. Single sessions were conducted per subject with target and non-target stimulus presentations. Trial intervals spanned 0 to 1.0 seconds with a 60 Hz line frequency.
